rules.name: High-Frequency RegisterForUpdate
rules.description: Script registers for an update interval under 0.5 seconds. Intervals this short run on every game frame and are a leading cause of script lag on large mod lists.
rules.remediation: Replace with RegisterForSingleUpdate() for one-shot callbacks, or increase the interval to 1.0+ seconds for polling loops.

rules.name: Uncapped While Loop
rules.description: A While loop was detected that contains no Utility.Wait() call. Without a yield point the Papyrus VM cannot interrupt the loop between ticks, locking the thread until the condition resolves.
rules.remediation: Add Utility.Wait(0.1) or higher inside the loop body to yield the thread on each iteration.

rules.name: Uncached Game.GetPlayer() in OnUpdate
rules.description: Multiple Game.GetPlayer() calls detected inside an OnUpdate event handler. Each call resolves the player form through the engine; caching it once costs nothing.
rules.remediation: Store the player reference in a script property (Actor Property PlayerRef Auto) or in OnInit, then reuse that variable instead of calling Game.GetPlayer() repeatedly.

rules.name: Empty Event Block
rules.description: An event handler is defined but contains no executable code. Empty event registrations still consume a hook slot in the engine event table.
rules.remediation: If this is not intentionally suppressing a parent class event, remove the empty block to reclaim the event-hook overhead.

rules.name: Orphaned Persistent Registration
rules.description: Script calls RegisterForUpdate, RegisterForModEvent, or RegisterForAnimationEvent (persistent loops that run until explicitly stopped) but has no UnregisterFor* call anywhere in the file. These registrations accumulate in save files every time the script activates across multiple play sessions, causing save bloat and increasing load-door stall time.
rules.remediation: Add UnregisterForUpdate / UnregisterForAllEvents / UnregisterFromAllModEvents in a cleanup handler such as OnDeath, OnUnequipped, OnEffectFinish, or OnUnload. If a single-fire pattern is intended, replace RegisterForUpdate with RegisterForSingleUpdate.

rules.name: ActiveMagicEffect Missing OnEffectFinish
rules.description: Script extends ActiveMagicEffect and calls RegisterFor* but defines no OnEffectFinish event block. When the magic effect expires or is dispelled, all registrations remain active in the Papyrus event system and persist in the save file indefinitely.
rules.remediation: Add an OnEffectFinish(Actor Target, Actor Caster) event block containing the appropriate UnregisterFor* calls to clean up when the effect ends.
